plan.decisionsNote: Twelve choices; each has the default the dispatcher builds if nobody objects.
plan.phasesNote: A phase starts when the gate under the previous one is passed; phases 1 and 2 can run side by side.

1.title: The accent colour
1.default: A hot pink beside the logo blue, or the blue, the orange or a colour the club chooses under «Theme v2»; emails, PDFs, race numbers and share cards stay blue.

2.title: The heading face
2.default: Inter 800 for headings, self-hosted with ș ț ă â î; the body stays Roboto.

3.title: A real home page
3.default: A real home page at `/ro` and `/en`, reached from the logo — never a menu entry — switchable on and off in «Aspect» → «Pagina principală».

4.title: The four menu words
4.default: «Alergări», «Calendar», «Comunitatea» — a club page linking the team, the gallery, the FAQ and the members' zone — and «Despre noi».

5.title: Where «Vino cu noi» goes
5.default: To the next weekly run's page; «Cum funcționează» opens a club page.

6.title: Photographs
6.default: Real club photos from the gallery only; people in a home-page photo have agreed.

7.title: The Instagram block
7.default: A static strip of six gallery pictures with a link; no live feed.

8.title: The numbers band
8.default: Typed under «Aspect» → «Pagina principală»: the founding date and the active runners; the rest computed from the events.

9.title: What «Evenimente speciale» means
9.default: Everything that is not a weekly series; the chip «Ediție specială» keeps its meaning.

10.title: The round arrow on cards
10.default: None: the home page shows the very cards of «Alergări», with their text door, «Descrierea completă a evenimentului».

11.title: Icons
11.default: The filled Material family stays; the lighter look comes from colour, weight and spacing.

12.title: How it ships
12.default: Behind one setting, «Theme v2»: on for QA, off on production until the club approves; Theme v1 deleted one release after the flip.

how: In Mailgun: Sending → Domains → “Add new domain”. Name: {mailDomain}. Region: EU. Not the main domain — that stays free for the club's own mailboxes.
Mailgun shows the DNS records to create: two TXT (SPF and DKIM) and one CNAME (tracking).
Add them at ROMARG → cPanel → Zone Editor exactly as Mailgun shows them, with the short name (no repeated domain).
Mind the DKIM one: the value is over 255 characters and cPanel cuts it — enter it as two quoted strings on one line (“k=rsa; p=…first part” “…the rest”), or Mailgun sees it truncated.
Then “Verify” in Mailgun — up to an hour.
Still in Mailgun: Sending → API keys → a sending key (MAILGUN_API_KEY).
Sending → Webhooks → copy the “HTTP webhook signing key” (MAILGUN_WEBHOOK_SIGNING_KEY) and add the webhook {webhookUrl} for “Permanent Failure” and “Spam Complaints”.
The two the application acts on (a rejected address shows at the desk and on the registration). “Delivered” is optional.
In Vercel, the production project → Settings → Environment Variables (or `vercel env add NAME production`): MAILGUN_DOMAIN={mailDomain}, MAILGUN_API_KEY, MAILGUN_WEBHOOK_SIGNING_KEY.
In the same place: MAILGUN_API_BASE_URL=https://api.eu.mailgun.net/v3 and EMAIL_REPLY_TO=a mailbox the club reads.
If no such mailbox exists yet, leave EMAIL_REPLY_TO unset: an empty one is refused at startup.
The sender is “{senderName}” <noreply@{mailDomain}> with no further setting — the name in EMAIL_FROM_NAME, the club’s own name by default.
Rehearse on QA, not on production: production refuses registrations until the legal texts are approved.
On the QA Vercel project set the same MAILGUN_DOMAIN, MAILGUN_API_KEY, MAILGUN_API_BASE_URL (the mode stays allowlist, EMAIL_ALLOWLIST=your address), redeploy, register on QA.
The email comes from noreply@{mailDomain}. When it does: on production EMAIL_DELIVERY_MODE=live, redeploy. This row turns green.
